_comment: Fixed A/B task set for scripts/skill-ab-eval.mjs (two arms: bare vs the skill with its whole folder mounted). Graders check what the skill claims to add beyond the bare model: its artifact contract (sections other svc tooling reads) and, where possible, correctness. Every grader must reject empty, whitespace-only and keyword-only answers: min_words and per-heading section bodies enforce substance, and test-framework/fixtures/skill-ab/grader-fixtures.json holds the negative fixtures that prove it. Paid: run with EVALS=1 (default runner claude -p). Verdicts need >= 5 finished runs per arm and p < .05; fewer is inconclusive. Extend per skill before slimming or retiring it.

tasks.prompt: Write a feature spec for: users can export their invoices as CSV from the invoices page. Output only the spec markdown.

grader._note: Contract keywords alone (Status/Acceptance Criteria/Given) no longer pass: the AC section needs a body, the spec must be about CSV invoice export, and placeholders are rejected.

diagnose-bug's own brief contract (P2 Reproduction, P3 Root Cause, pattern scan, Pillar Revisit Audit) with a body under each heading, plus the correct fix direction (ceil). Root Cause must also name floor, the actual defect. Headings alone or filler do not pass.

tasks.prompt: Single-user desktop app, cloud sync maybe next year. Postgres or SQLite? Give me the decision.

grader._note: A decision needs the recommended option, a stated confidence, the alternative it was weighed against and a reason tied to the question (sync, migration, concurrency, server). Three keywords alone do not pass.
